proof.text: Comap q along the right inclusion of the quotient into its fibre. The resulting prime ideal proves the quotient A is nontrivial. Construct its polynomial presentation P and identify P.Cotangent with I.Cotangent using cotangentEquivCotangentKer and equivOfEq, extending scalars along the surjective presentation map.

The polynomial algebra is formally smooth, and smoothness of A makes H1Cotangent R A subsingleton. Mathlib Algebra.Extension.cotangentComplex_injective_iff gives injectivity of the conormal differential. Conjugate this map by b.equivFun and P.cotangentSpaceBasis.equivFun to obtain an injective A-linear map A^c to A^n.

The nontrivial commutative ring A satisfies the strong rank condition. Apply Mathlib card_le_of_injective to the constructed coordinate map and simplify the cardinalities of Fin c and Fin n to obtain c ≤ n.

proof_origin.note: Direct Mathlib conormal injectivity and strong rank condition proof; same polynomial conormal argument as the source, without residue-field tensoring.

lean.statement:
theorem smooth_quotient_fibre_finrank_add_le
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n c : ℕ} (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    [Smooth R (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))]
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin c)
      (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))
      (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).Cotangent)
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum (p.Fiber (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)))) :
    c ≤ n
